tests.runtime: existing local simulation venv, NumPy2.5.4/MuJoCo3.17; earlier17-test remote run used NumPy2.2.6
tests.linux_note: Optional numpy/MuJoCo module-level imports cause this entire test module to skip in the foundation-only CI environment.

limitations: Hand-only seven-second teacher schedule; no pad, GUI, policy training or randomized task result on H800.
Every world repeats the same initial state/control. Final-state agreement does not prove workspace/generalization performance.
World0 contact/state checks are sampled every20 steps plus final; all-world state checks every200 steps plus final. Not every-step/all-world contact acceptance.
GPU solver warnings remain unknown. Capacity peaks are sampled, not a proof of no overflow between samples.
CPU contacts were refreshed after stepping; GPU contacts retain pre-integration solver-step values. No instantaneous contact-alignment equivalence is claimed.
Primary throughput includes control transfer, Python and observation. Observation-excluded time is not pure kernel time. No end-to-end training speedup or CPU-batch comparison is claimed.

Both Kimi GPU dispatches timed out after900.1s. Actual remote jobs were independently reconciled: first failed in141s; corrected job completed in466s. No training or ongoing GPU allocation remains from these two jobs.
